allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "C:\\flutter\\bin\\flutter.bat" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\flutter\\bin\\flutter.bat" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem "C:\\src\\flutter\\bin\\flutter.bat" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
